thread:
emily: Heads-up: All staff must complete the annual Privacy & Data Handling microtraining by end of day Fri. This is a hard deadline tied to our Q2 attestation. Please read, complete, and mark the form. :books: 

emily: Link to training & attestation: https://redwood-internal.example/training/privacy-2026 (est. 12-18m). If you have a blocker, see the late window below.

raj: Quick Q 1 1 1 Is the training required for contractors too?

nate: Contractors with access to prod or customer data must complete it. Contractors without data access can be exempted but PMs need to confirm in the tracker.

olivia: Is there a quiz? I remember last year had a short quiz and certificate.

emily: Yes 1 short quiz (5 questions). On passing you get the attestation checkbox to submit. If you fail, you can retake immediately.

tina: For folks on-call overseas: our timezone office hours are awful. Any async option for attestations?

hr-bot: Async option: the attestation form accepts a timestamped response. If you complete the module and submit the form, that satisfies the requirement. No live attendance required.

emily: Late window: Weve scheduled a 48h grace window (MonTue) ONLY for documented operational conflicts (on-call, customer incident, travel). Submit a short exception via this form with your manager cc: https://redwood-internal.example/forms/train-exception. Approvals are manual.

raj: For evidence/documents tied to the SOC2 control, do we need to upload a copy of the certificate to s3 or just keep the attestation form?

emily: Two things: 1) The training attestation is separate (people-ops keeps that). 2) For SOC2 evidence where a control maps to training completion, please add a pointer in the control checklist (Control: HR-2) with the attestation form ID. No need to upload PDFs for each person.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: Training deadline Fri 23:59 PT. Automated nudges start Thu 09:00 PT for incomplete staff.

nate: Heads-up for platform teams: customers on private deployments (air-gapped) require manual ingestion of attestation logs into their evidence bucket. Were providing a templated CSV in the tracker.

emily: Correct. If you support air-gapped customers, follow the "Private Ingestion" steps in the tracker (col: Private Instr). If youre the PM for a private customer, please confirm ingestion by ticking the checklist.

olivia: Exec ask: do C-levels need to do anything differently this year?

cxo-bot: Execs must complete the same module and submit the attestation form; additionally, each exec signs off on org-level policy changes via the exec attestation doc. Link: https://redwood-internal.example/exec-attest-2026
tina: If someone is on parental leave, are they exempt?

emily: Parental leave is an approved exemption. Please have your manager add the leave note to the tracker and file an exemption via the form so our auditors have a record.

raj: Any post-deadline catch-up process?

emily: Yes: there will be a 2-week remediation window for folks who missed due to approved exceptions. HR will run a report and reach out. Repeated misses will trigger manager follow-up.

olivia: Thanks 1 will push to my team now.

emily: Office hours this Wed 16:00 PT for quick Q&A and attestation help: https://meet.example/privacy-qa. Thanks everyone, please ack in the tracker after completion. :thumbsup:
